purpose: Exercise the observation-to-candidate-to-regression chain end to end, including a byte-exact rollback on rejection.

provenance.not_evidence_of: LLM quality, or that any real learned change improves behavior

oracle_policy.description: Dispositions are derived by evaluating the checks below against candidate content. No candidate supplies its own score, and no score is copied from a candidate into the result.
oracle_policy.rationale: Reusing a candidate's self-reported score as evidence that the candidate worked is circular, and it is the easiest mistake to make because the number is already present.
